name: agteamos-context-budget

estimation.telemetry: estimate-only; host context-window usage is not available

rules: Counts use UTF-8 file bytes and are deterministic for the same filesystem snapshot.
Token values are estimates, never host telemetry or billing data.
Only active-change artifacts and explicitly referenced context are counted.
Generated HTML, cache, evidence binaries, source code and external payloads are excluded.
